stops.title: Frɔm Vizitɔ to Mɛmba
stops.caption: Fo stej, wan lis.
stops.speech: Ɔlman de sidɔm sɔm say pan di sem jɔni: vizitɔ, ritɔna, dɛn mɛmba wan tɛm di fo-wik klas dɔn.

stops.title: Usay Stetɔs de Sho
stops.caption: Pan di layn, ɛn pan di prɔfayl.
stops.speech: Di dairɛktri layn de sho wetin stej pɔsin de, so yu kin si wantɛm udat nɔbɔdi nɔ eva fɔlo ɔp.
